environment.install: fresh standalone educational editable with optuna,notebooks,test extras and pinned Linux CPU profile

verified: Actual one-epoch MLP and TwoStageDB studies returned observed validation R2, NLL and mean Winkler in the declared maximize/minimize/minimize order.
Training and validation trial attributes matched independent calls to their existing scorers (21 filled training labels and 13 observed validation labels).
Two-stage prediction source contributions summed exactly to total prediction; existing model/preprocessor and search-weight contracts were preserved.
An actual MLP training study resumed from 1 to 2 trials without altering the first trial.
Controlled trade-off vectors produced the known Pareto set and lowest-NLL representative; an explicitly selected Pareto trial loaded, and a dominated trial selection was rejected.
CSV exports preserved objective values, Pareto flags, raw width exponents and resolved model widths without ambiguity.
JSON exports preserved full settings/metrics, including null for undefined training R2; negative finite NLL was accepted.
A 15-trial adaptive TPE run and a 5-to-15 resumed run produced identical parameters and objective values, preserving prior timestamps/attributes and scaler bytes.
Repeating the completed trial target performed no new fits; reducing the requested total was rejected.
Failed and zero-allocation interrupted studies exported coherent empty/failed history and resumed successfully.
Nonfinite objective values, constant/missing/single-observation validation targets, mismatched manifest/settings and missing SQLite history were rejected.
Single-objective study directories were not overwritten or reused.
limitations: Linux CPU validation only; native macOS, Windows and GPU execution were not performed.
Actual fits used small schema-matched fixtures and a one-epoch budget; no research predictive performance is claimed.
Longer adaptive sampler/Pareto tests used inexpensive controlled objective stubs through the real multiobjective adapter, sampler and SQLite persistence.
No existing notebook files were modified or executed; this request adds a Python tuning module.
preservation: All pre-existing project files were byte-identical to the input archive before rebuilding distribution artifacts and SHA256SUMS. No existing code, notebooks, installer metadata or dependency requirements were edited.
